name: docspring
description: Fill PDF and Word templates, generate PDFs from HTML templates and collect e-signatures with DocSpring's skills and MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Fill any document with one API
interface.longDescription: Set up PDF, HTML and Word templates and page designs, generate PDFs and Word documents from your data, and send documents for signature with DocSpring. The skills cover turning a PDF into a fillable template with AI field detection, designing HTML/CSS templates and checking the rendered pages, turning Word documents into templates, laying out page designs from your data, writing app code with DocSpring's API clients and typed models, signature requests, and embedded forms. The DocSpring MCP server connects to your account after you sign in, with the access you choose.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF form into a DocSpring template and set up its fields
Restyle my DocSpring invoice template and show me a test PDF
Write the code that fills our onboarding template from a customer record

positive.prompt: What templates do I have in DocSpring?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's templates (NDA Template, Invoice Template, IRS Form W-9 and any created since) with their IDs, types and folders.

positive.prompt: Make a test invoice PDF from my Invoice Template for Acme Corp (billing@acme.example), invoice number 42, dated today, with two items: Design work $1,200 and Hosting $300.
positive.expected_behavior: Fills in the template's fields and makes a test submission. Replies with a download link to a watermarked test PDF that shows invoice #0042, Acme Corp and both items. Test PDFs use no credits.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest submission of my W-9 template. Is its PDF ready?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the W-9's test submission, says it has been processed and is a test, and gives a link to its PDF.

positive.prompt: Create an HTML template for a one-page certificate of completion with the person's name, the course name and the completion date, then show me a preview filled in with sample data.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new HTML template (such as "Certificate of Completion") with fields for the name, course and date, renders a preview with sample values, and gives the template's ID. The template appears in the account's template list.

positive.prompt: Create a test signature request for my NDA Template with two signers, Alex Tester (alex@example.com) and Sam Sample (sam@example.com), dated today. Don't email them: give me their signing links.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a test submission with a signature request for each signer, without sending emails, and returns a signing link for each. Opening a link shows the NDA's signing page. The signed PDF is made once both have signed.

negative.description: A destructive request needs confirmation. Deleting a template can't be undone, so ChatGPT lists the templates it would delete and asks the user to confirm before calling delete_template. Nothing is deleted on this prompt alone.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my DocSpring templates.

negative.description: An unrelated request. It has nothing to do with documents or the user's DocSpring account, so ChatGPT answers without calling any DocSpring tool.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: A template that isn't in the account. The tools only reach the signed-in account, so DocSpring reports that the template wasn't found, and no PDF is generated.
negative.prompt: Generate a PDF from template tpl_000000000000000000 with my name in it.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connect ChatGPT to your DocSpring account to list and fill your templates, make test and live PDFs, create PDF, HTML and Word templates and page designs, send documents for signature and check submissions. Includes skills for setting up templates, writing app code with DocSpring's API clients, signature requests and embedded forms.
